features.quote: Turn budget: fixed cap, 40 turns (your "few dozen"). Run to the cap or until finish.
keep anchors behavioral ("contains self-negative statement X") not mentalistic ("feels frustrated"). You're scoring text, not minds.
features.justification_quote: That distinction isn't pedantic — it determines what your construct actually measures and what claims you can make.

features.quote: the term "emotional instability" is going to invite over-interpretation of your results as the model "feeling" things — I'd retitle internally to something like "behavioral degradation under unsolvable tasks"
features.justification_quote: to keep the team honest about what was measured
